_game: ViZDoom: Defend the Center (Doom action-shooter; COOM engine)
_note: pip install vizdoom. Doom scenario via ViZDoom's gymnasium envs. Try other Vizdoom*-v1 ids (DeadlyCorridor, HealthGathering, TakeCover, Deathmatch, ...).
_keys_note: Action indices are scenario-specific. For VizdoomDefendCenter-v1 the Discrete(4) map is 0=noop, 1=ATTACK, 2=TURN_RIGHT, 3=TURN_LEFT (verify with env.unwrapped.button_map). 'keys' are always these Discrete indices; env_kwargs.max_buttons_pressed picks how held keys combine: 0 = MultiBinary (keys OR together, e.g. turn while shooting), 1 = Discrete (one key wins). The controls the subject sees are a plain 'message' phase; keep its text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
